name: lingtai
description: Connect Codex to LingTai agent networks through the shared human mailbox.

interface.shortDescription: Mail and manage your LingTai agents
interface.longDescription: Read and send mail as the human of a LingTai agent network, check which agents are alive, and sleep, suspend, refresh or restart them. The skill reads the protocol the network writes about itself (.lingtai/human/README.md and each agent's SKILL.md).
